question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experiment-gated Claw lifecycle diagnostic as a core Doctor contribution before the open Claws RFC and prerequisite ownership slices have been accepted?
rationale: The patch adds a new core diagnostic surface rather than repairing an established contract, and the protected maintainer label plus open RFC/stack indicate that code review alone cannot decide the intended product boundary and landing order.

options.title: Hold for RFC and stack sponsorship
options.body: Pause this slice until an owner confirms the Claws core scope and sequencing, then rebase it onto the accepted ownership model and address the WAL defect.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow diagnostics slice
options.body: Explicitly approve a reduced, read-only Doctor diagnostic scope after the shared migration detector is repaired and upgrade behavior is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Hold for RFC and stack sponsorship
recommendation.body: Pause this slice until an owner confirms the Claws core scope and sequencing, then rebase it onto the accepted ownership model and address the WAL defect.

likelyOwner.reason: The review timeline explicitly routed this experimental stack to steipete; code-history ownership could not be established from the supplied review material.
